name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.0 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 16 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 15 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 16 hours starting 2025-08-27, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 1.05 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
